Hi Alex / Priya —

Quick note as we prep for the next phase of the MAP. Based on the timeline you shared, it looks like the evaluation window shifts earlier next week and we should align our weekly checkpoints so owners can surface runbook items and any blockers before the evaluation starts.

Proposed changes:
- Move the weekly MAP sync from Thursdays to Wednesdays (30 min) for the next three weeks — this gives your team one business day to act before the evaluation window opens on Friday.
- Agenda: 1) status on integration tasks, 2) evaluation readiness (data, test prompts), 3) who needs access/credentials, 4) open risks and mitigations. I attached an updated agenda and an evaluation checklist for review.
- Owners: Karthik (integration health), Neha (eval readiness + metrics), Vanessa (escalations / timeline).

Can you confirm whether Wed morning PST (9:30am PT) works for you both? If not, send a couple of preferred slots and we’ll propose alternatives that span your CET/IST overlaps.

Thanks — want to make sure we don’t compress your prep window.

—Vanessa

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the proactive move.

Wed 9:30am PT is 5:30pm for our team in London, which is doable but tight. Priya and I prefer something earlier for us (2:30pm GMT / 6:30am PT would be rough for you). If possible, could we try 11:00am PT (7:00pm GMT) one week and then alternate for the following weeks? Alternatively, a recurring time at 8:00am PT would catch Karthik + Vanessa comfortably and be late afternoon for us.

On the eval checklist — looks good. A couple of items:
- We need a scoped list of golden prompts and expected quality buckets (Neha, can you add those?).
- Access: we still need tokenization logs for the staging env — Marcus, can you confirm?

We’re happy to be flexible with the cadence; the most important thing for Peregrine is that we have a final dry-run 48 hours before the evaluation window opens.

—Alex
